scientific_integrity.claim_type: Exact value-by-value count for the associative commutator map on strictly upper-triangular four-by-four matrices over all finite fields.
scientific_integrity.finite_checks: Full direct enumeration of 4096, 531441 and 16777216 ordered pairs for field sizes 2, 3, and 4; independent projected counts and adjoint-rank spectra over 2, 3, and 5.
scientific_integrity.limitations: No claims for sizes other than four or for arbitrary coefficient rings. The zero-fiber count for odd fields is implied by earlier unitriangular-group commuting-probability work. Unknown prior literature could contain equivalent nonzero-fiber formulas; publication priority is not independently certified.
scientific_integrity.proof_basis: Explicit matrix-unit multiplication; two-dimensional projected bilinear determinant count; uniform nonzero linear-functional fibers; exceptional degeneracy at zero.
